# Voice of America (VOA)

> > Voice of America is the U.S. government's international multimedia news broadcaster, delivering independent journalism in 40+ languages across global regions including the Balkans, Africa, and Eastern Europe.

VOA provides comprehensive coverage of U.S. and world news, including ongoing conflicts in Ukraine and Syria, international politics, and regional developments. The service operates multiple language-specific editions including Bosnian (Glas Amerike) and Amharic, offering radio programs, articles, and multimedia content to audiences worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Voice of America (VOA)
- International news and global affairs
- U.S. government and politics
- Ukraine-Russia conflict
- Balkan region coverage (Bosnia & Herzegovina)
- Glas Amerike (Bosnian service)
- Studio Washington
- Middle East affairs (Syria, Kremlin relations)
- African news (South Africa, Uzbekistan)
- Multimedia journalism (TV programs, radio)
- Regional politics and diplomacy
- Trump administration coverage
- Senate and U.S. legislative news
- Independent journalism in 40+ languages

## Main News Hubs

- [VOA - Voice of America English News](https://www.voanews.com): Main homepage for VOA English news covering U.S. and international developments with comprehensive global coverage
- [Glas Amerike | Bosna i Hercegovina](https://ba.voanews.com/): VOA Bosnian service homepage delivering news, analysis, and multimedia content for Bosnia & Herzegovina audiences

## International & Conflict Coverage

- [Ukrajina: Protuzračna odbrana srušila 34 od 35 ruskih dronova](https://ba.voanews.com/a/ukrajina-rusija-napad-dronovima/7406903.html): Ukraine air defense successfully intercepts 34 of 35 Russian drones in latest military engagement

## Regional Language Services

- [Amharic News 1800 - የአሜሪካ ድምፅ](https://amharic.voanews.com/one-hour-radio-show/articles): VOA Amharic one-hour radio show featuring articles and comprehensive news coverage for Ethiopian audiences

## Health & Public Interest

- [Koronavirus: Maske su za bolesne i zdravstveno osoblje](https://ba.voanews.com/a/koronavirus-maske-su-za-bolesne-i-zdravstveno-osoblje-ne-stite-od-virusa-/5316051.html): Coronavirus mask usage guidance for medical personnel and patients in Bosnia & Herzegovina

## Optional

- [Novogodišnja proslava širom svijeta](https://ba.voanews.com/a/novogodisnja-proslava-sirom-svijeta/5227776.html): New Year celebrations coverage from major global cities including New York and Paris
